name: Himi ☆ Tsui
source:
Yuuta loves "bukkake". He waits for Ringo, his girlfriend who allows him to do bukkake to her, coming back from trip. One night, he gets excited to see Miu, his sister, sleeping on the sofa and does bukkake to her. He tries to wipe it up, but she wakes up. He apologizes her, but she says, "I'll keep it secret, so please do it again tomorrow..."

[From ErogeShop]
translation: 雄太喜欢"颜射"。他等待着允许他颜射的女朋友铃木旅行归来。某天晚上，他看到妹妹美羽睡在沙发上，一时兴起对她进行了颜射。他试图擦干净，但她醒了。他向她道歉，但她却说："我会保密的，所以明天也请继续……"\n\n[改编自ErogeShop]
